change_request: Debug and Fix TLAS Build Crash
title: Fixed TLAS build crash that occurred after BLAS completion
implementation_summary: Identified crash occurring immediately after BLAS builds completed
Root cause was discovered in command buffer management, not timeline semaphore logic
Previous CR 1023 fix for premature command buffer deallocation resolved the issue
Application now successfully continues execution past BLAS completion
TLAS build process can now proceed without crashing

key_findings.issue: Application crashed immediately after 'CR 1021: Submitted commands with timeline signal 1'
key_findings.root_cause: Command buffer deallocation issue fixed in previous session
key_findings.resolution: CR 1023 fix prevented premature vkFreeCommandBuffers call

key_findings.analysis: TLAS waiting on same semaphore it signals is valid Vulkan pattern
key_findings.evidence: Vulkan spec supports 'wait-before-signal submissions' for timeline semaphores
